A fine grid of the half court labelled by zone

Source: R/court.R
court_zone_grid.Rd

Used to paint zone charts: each cell of a res-metre grid is classified with shot_zone(), so zone shapes follow the real court lines exactly without hand-made polygons.

Usage

court_zone_grid(
  league = "NBA",
  detail = TRUE,
  res = 0.05,
  ymax = 9.25,
  rim_r = 1.75,
  short_r = 4.25
)

Arguments

league

League rules, recycled.

detail

Return the 13 side-split zones.

res

Grid resolution in metres.

ymax

Depth of the grid from the hoop.

rim_r, short_r

Radii (m) of the rim area and of short mid-range.
